name: THADDAEUS
canonical: Thaddaeus, also called Judas the son of James, a gentle warm-natured apostle of about forty with soft sun-warmed olive skin and a kind round mild face, calm tender compassionate eyes and a gentle settled mouth, greying wavy brown hair thinning at the crown and a soft rounded grizzled grey-brown beard, dressed in a warm earthen ochre-brown tunic and a soft tan head-cloth bound simply across his brow, both hands resting peaceably at his breast
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
